observed_gate_gap.finding: The v4 promotion gate required output-code label counterbalance for token-output metrics but did not require requested semantic targets themselves to be counterbalanced. Therefore an all-AFFIRMATIVE evaluation could satisfy the declared scientific-independence fields despite the active supervisor explicitly requiring a label-independent/counterbalanced discriminator.
observed_gate_gap.counterhypothesis: A positive +VECTOR effect may be generic instruction compliance, confidence, task engagement or requested-code emission rather than AFFIRMATIVE-specific causal semantics.

implemented_delta.workflow_note: No GitHub workflow run was observed for the regression commit at research time; test source presence is not test execution.

parallel_fusion.lexical_deconfound_finding: Explicit AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL pole words and nearby synonyms in basis/evaluation prompts can reconstruct a lexical axis; semantic-target counterbalance alone does not remove this confound. Label-free cross-lexical basis families, a lexical nuisance control, coherence diagnostics and per-family interaction evidence are required before semantic promotion.
parallel_fusion.token_scope_finding: The credited PyTorch intervention is last-token-only while native llama.cpp cvec applies the additive direction across prompt-token positions present in the decode batch; agreement is not strict intervention replication until scope is matched.
parallel_fusion.low_gain_scope: Calibration search domain changed from high gains to 0.25/0.5/1/2/4 only; this does not by itself establish residual-norm comparability or close semantic/lexical/token-scope confounds.
